segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Hello, let's quickly go over the release plan for the new product. Are we still forgetting? Are we still targeting Friday?

segments.text: Ah, yes. Friday still looks realistic. The backend is mostly complete, but we need final testing before we push anything to production.

segments.speaker: Saeed
segments.text: Okay, then let's make a decision now. We will keep Friday as the release date, provided QA is completed by Thursday evening.

segments.text: Yeah, sure. Why not? I will take ownership of the final backend test. And make sure it is done by Thursday at 5 p.m.

segments.text: One concern is that our mobile experience. The latest build still has small layout issues on the meeting summary screen.

segments.text: Great. Also, one another thing, we should avoid releasing directory to everyone. Let's first roll it out to around 10% of users, monitor error for a few hours, and then expand the rollout.
